children: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent testified in front of the House Financial Services for nearly three hours Tuesday. Here are some highlights from Bessent at the lively session.
"This is a November decision. This versus that," Bessent said, pointing to himself then to protesters who had interrupted his testimony.
"Representative Waters, you're not making sense," the Treasury secretary said, responding to questions from Rep. Maxine Waters (D., Calif.) that linked high inflation with Trump's tariffs.
Bessent when asked about a decline in consumer sentiment as measured by the University of Michigan: "There's a survey problem because Democrats are now poisoning the survey."
Responding to questions from Waters on whether AI development should stop or slow down in response to concerns from major tech players. "They could stop any time they want to."
Read more on Bessent's comments on artificial intelligence, possible "Trump dividends" after the election and recent moves in Treasury yields.
